title: Telemetry stack TF module: helm-based OTel + Prometheus/Grafana + log forwarder - migration and health checks
creator: Leah Park
description:
Scope: Build a Terraform module for Redwood Private observability that deploys a production-ready telemetry stack into customer VPC clusters via Helm releases managed from Terraform. The module will install and configure: (1) OpenTelemetry Collector (collector) as a set of DaemonSets/Deployments with OTLP receivers and exporters; (2) Prometheus (kube-prometheus-stack or equivalent) with serviceMonitors and alerting rules; (3) Grafana with provisioning for dashboards and datasources; (4) Log forwarder (Vector or Fluentd) as a DaemonSet forwarding to configured backends (S3/ELK/third-party). It must: support secure secrets (KMS integration), configurable retention/per-namespace scraping, k8s readiness/liveness probes, and a documented upgrade/migration path from the current observability Terraform module (v1.x) to the new module (v2.0).

Goals: Provide a single reusable Terraform module that can be onboarded into customer Private clusters with minimal manual steps, includes non-destructive upgrade logic, and exposes health check resources (Prometheus rules, Synthetic probes) for Console SLO dashboards. Ensure the module is testable in CI (kind/minikube) and has clear rollback steps if Helm chart CRDs change.

Non-goals: This ticket does not include a migration automation tool that migrates existing persisted Grafana data between backends. That will be a follow-up if customers request stateful migrations.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module deploys all components (OTel collector, Prometheus stack, Grafana, log forwarder) to a test cluster via 'terraform apply' with Helm provider
Module exposes variables for chart version pins, values overrides, and KMS-encrypted secret references
Upgrade path documented: steps to move from v1.x module to v2.0 without causing alert storms or data loss
Kubernetes readiness/liveness probes present for core components and verified in CI smoke tests
Prometheus serviceMonitors and alerting rules are created and validate target scraping in e2e tests
Module has automated tf-validate and helm unit tests in CI; sample overlay for private customer template included
Security review checklist completed and PR merged with required reviewers
migration_plan:
Phase 1: Implement new module in terraform-modules repo under modules/observability-helm with feature flag 'enable_new_obs'. Phase 2: Add CI job (kind) that provisions the module and runs smoke tests (prometheus scrape, grafana provisioning, log shipper connectivity). Phase 3: Offer a dual-deploy compatibility shim for a small set of customers (side-by-side deploy) to validate behavior before switching traffic. Phase 4: Documentation + runbook for support and SREs, including rollback and Grafana datasource fallback. Phase 5: Gradual rollout to Dedicated clusters followed by Private customer onboards.

Migration notes: Grafana persistence is optional; if customers use PVC-backed Grafana, provide guidance but do not attempt automated snapshot migration in this ticket. For CRD upgrades, include preflight detection (helm diff) and a mode to apply CRD changes only after manual approval.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge module behind feature flag. 2) Enable for internal staging clusters and run 72-hour soak tests. 3) Enable in a single non-critical customer Private cluster with monitoring on alert noise. 4) If stable, schedule migration window for remaining customers with communication template. 5) Post-rollout retrospective and follow-up issues for collected action items.
testing_plan: - Unit: terraform validate, tflint on module code. - Integration: CI job that creates a kind cluster, runs terraform apply, waits for pods ready, runs prometheus queries to assert target scrape counts, verifies grafana provisioning endpoints, and posts logs to a test S3. - Chaos: restart collector and verify automatic reconnection/exporter backoff and recovery. - Performance: measure collector CPU and memory for 1000 eps simulated traffic in CI perf harness.
implementation_notes:
Technical choices: Use Terraform Helm provider to manage chart lifecycle and values; prefer community 'kube-prometheus-stack' for Prometheus unless chart changes force us to fork. Use the OpenTelemetry Helm chart for collector and support customizing pipelines via values. For log shipping prefer Vector for lower memory footprint; make log backend pluggable. Keep secrets out of tfstate by using references to KMS-wrapped secrets or Kubernetes ExternalSecrets (configurable). Add explicit lifecycle blocks and 'helm_release' force_update toggles only where safe.

Health checks: Create Prometheus recording rules for 'up' targets and an alert rule for missing exporters. Provide Grafana folder provisioning with a 'Telemetry - Cluster Health' dashboard and a sample uptime SLO derived from Prometheus queries. Add a synthetic Kubernetes probe job (cronjob) that hits the collector and asserts ingestion latency (optional toggle).
open_questions: Do we standardize on Vector for all customers or keep Fluentd as an opt-in option?
What is the minimum supported k8s version for the new module (we need to ensure compatibility with older Private clusters)?
Who owns Grafana persistence migration runbooks if customers request stateful migration?
Should the module include its own RBAC roles or rely on cluster-admin to supply an RBAC bundle?
